metadata.sourcePolicy: Values transcribed from uploaded PDFs; absent columns remain blank. Team totals are not combined across clubs or added to player ranking.

opponentTeams.Notes: Five-game official ladder; only 27.2 pitcher innings identified, missing appearance(s). 9 ER in partial ledger; 11 official runs allowed. Player stats provisional.

opponentTeams.Source: User-supplied ladder and five game batches
opponentTeams.Notes: Preliminary: 48 RF, 28 RA, +20 RD; Nov 10 win already in ladder but individual stats not yet published. Next game pending.

metadata.melbournePitchingSourceCaveat: The uploaded game-row pitching R fields sum to 8, which conflicts with the final score of 4 runs allowed; team standings use the official final score. Pitching ER/H/BB/SO/IP are provisionally transcribed from the supplied row format.
metadata.melbourneBattingSourceCaveat: Melbourne OBP and OPS are estimates due to unavailable full historical HBP/SF/CI. OBP=(H+BB)/(AB+BB); OPS=unrounded estimated OBP + total bases/AB, rounded once to 3 decimal places.
metadata.melbourneStatPolicy: 8-game cumulative stats, with provisional Game 8 mapping flagged. Official ladder 8th, 4–4–0, RF52 RA57.
metadata.sandringhamSourceCaveat: Six-game totals from five-game scouting source plus November 7 4–3 win game rows. OBP/OPS recomputed as estimates using (H+BB)/(AB+BB) due to missing historical HBP/SF/CI. Player game run and earned-run data are not substitutes for ladder runs.
metadata.melbourneOBPMethod: Estimates using H, BB, AB and total bases; full historical HBP/SF/CI incomplete.
metadata.melbourneGame8SourceCaveat: GameDay player table supplied without column headers. PA/AB/R/H, doubles and common BB/SO mappings transcribed provisionally. Perrett pitching 6 IP, 4 H, 7 SO, 1 BB, 0 ER is a provisional interpretation of the row; verify against headed box score. GameDay player row totals do not fully reconcile with team run and hit summary. Ladder score/record authoritative.

moorabbinPreliminary.caveat: Six-game ladder, five player-stat batches; Nov 10 game player box score missing. Latest available samples and classifications are provisional.
